title: The public corrections log (Phase 2 spec, P5; D172, question 7)
description: One entry per published number that changed by a correction: what it was, what it became, why, when, with which official source and through which pull request. A number that changes by a change of method also has its decision (D number). Newest first.

date.description: The day the correction reached production (Brasília time).

page.description: The page and the place on it, as a reader finds it.

what.description: The number or text, with its period.

before.description: What the page showed, as shown.

after.description: What the page shows now, as shown.
